name: @w6w-apps/gocanvas
description: Forms, submissions, dispatches, customers, sites, projects, users and webhooks in GoCanvas.

w6w.longDescription:
GoCanvas is a mobile forms and field-data platform: teams design a Form once, field staff fill it in on a phone or tablet, and every completed Form becomes a Submission that can be reported on, routed through a Workflow or pushed to another system.

This app covers the GoCanvas REST API v3. A workflow can read the Forms a company has published and the Submissions captured against them, create or correct a Submission from another system, and Dispatch a pre-filled Form to a specific mobile user (immediately, on a schedule, or on a recurring schedule). Around that sit the records a Form hangs off: Customers, Sites and Projects, Departments, Users, Groups and Reference Data.

Webhooks are managed per Form, so a workflow can subscribe an endpoint to submission, dispatch and handoff events and send a test payload before relying on it. Authentication is the HTTP Basic login of a GoCanvas user, so use a dedicated API user whose role carries only the rights the workflow needs.
